info.name: Image Modifier API
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection for the Softcolon Image Modifier backend API.

Base URL: {{base_url}}/api/v1

**Auth Types:**
- Admin endpoints: Bearer JWT (from /admin/auth/login)
- User endpoints: Bearer Clerk Token
- Public endpoints: No auth required

variable.description: Base URL of the server. Change for production.
JWT access token for admin endpoints. Set after login.
JWT refresh token for admin endpoints.
Clerk JWT token for user-facing authenticated endpoints.
A plan UUID for subscription/plan endpoints.
A user UUID for admin user management endpoints.
A session UUID for session management endpoints.
A transaction UUID for reconciliation endpoints.

item.name: Authentication (Admin)
item.description: Admin authentication: login, token refresh, logout, profile, password reset, and session management.

request.description: Authenticate admin user with email and password. Returns access_token and refresh_token.
Refresh the admin access token using a valid refresh token.
Logout admin and revoke all tokens for this session.
Get the currently authenticated admin's profile information.
Send an OTP to the admin email to initiate a password reset.
Verify the 6-digit OTP code sent to the admin email.
Reset the admin password using a verified OTP code.
Get all active sessions for the currently authenticated admin.
Revoke a specific session by its ID.
Revoke all sessions except the current one.
Get paginated login history for the current admin.

item.name: User Authentication
item.description: User-facing authentication endpoints using Clerk tokens.

request.description: Get the currently authenticated user's profile information. Requires a valid Clerk Bearer token.

item.name: Image Modification
item.description: Public/user endpoints for image processing — validate, modify, and upscale images.

formdata.description: Image file to validate (JPEG/PNG). Must contain exactly one real human face.

request.description: Validate an uploaded image for face detection. Checks for exactly one real human face. No authentication required.

header.description: Required for 2K/4K upscaling. Optional for Original.

formdata.description: Alternative: target width in pixels — '2560' for 2K, '3840' for 4K, 'original' for no change. Use either target_resolution OR target_width.

request.description: Upscale an image to Original, 2K (2560px), or 4K (3840px) resolution. 2K and 4K require an active user subscription. Returns a PNG image.

header.description: Optional. Required to avoid anonymous quota limits.

formdata.description: Image file with a single human face (JPEG/PNG)
Optional: Additional instructions for background removal

request.description: Remove background from the image, keeping only the main subject (face). Action: remove-bg.
Convert image to a professional passport photo (standard mode — quality enhancement and pose correction).

formdata.description: suit — dress the person in a formal suit

request.description: Convert image to passport photo with a formal suit outfit applied.

formdata.value: Apply traditional Indian attire with white background
formdata.description: Custom instructions applied to the passport photo

request.description: Convert image to passport photo with custom user-specified styling instructions.

formdata.description: Background style. Options: white, black, grey, warm_grey, cool_grey, blue, gradient_blue, gradient_grey, plain, studio, custom
Custom background description (used when category=custom or omitted)

request.description: Replace image background with a preset or custom background. Style options: white, black, grey, warm_grey, cool_grey, blue, gradient_blue, gradient_grey, plain, studio.
Remove a specific object from the image and reconstruct the area.

formdata.value: Add a professional office background and enhance the lighting
formdata.description: Detailed instructions for the custom edit to apply

request.description: Apply a completely custom AI modification based on user-provided text instructions.

formdata.description: LinkedIn style. Options: classic_corporate, casual_professional, creative, founder_leader, friendly_approachable, monochrome_bw, studio_look, outdoor_natural, tech_modern

request.description: Generate a hyper-realistic LinkedIn headshot. Available styles: classic_corporate, casual_professional, creative, founder_leader, friendly_approachable, monochrome_bw, studio_look, outdoor_natural, tech_modern.

item.name: Subscriptions
item.description: Subscription management for users and admins (Stripe-based).

request.description: Get a list of all active subscription plans. Public endpoint, no authentication required.
Admin endpoint to create a new subscription plan.
Request a plan subscription. Currently sales-managed — no direct payment. Returns a contact-sales message.
Get the current user's active subscription with aggregated quota information.
Get the full subscription history (all plans, all statuses) for the current user.

header.description: Stripe webhook signature — generated by Stripe, not manually set.

request.description: ⚠️ Internal webhook endpoint called by Stripe. Do not call manually in production. Handles: checkout.session.completed, payment_intent.succeeded, invoice.payment_succeeded, customer.subscription.deleted.
Request a Razorpay plan subscription. Currently sales-managed. Returns a contact-sales message.

header.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the request body using the Razorpay webhook secret. Generated by Razorpay.

request.description: ⚠️ Internal webhook called by Razorpay. Do not call manually in production. Handles: payment.captured, subscription.charged.

item.name: Admin - User Management
item.description: Admin endpoints to list, view, update, and manage users and their plans.

query.description: Search by email, phone, or name
Max records to return. Min: 1, Max: 100 (default: 50)

request.description: Get a paginated and filtered list of all users. Rate limited to 30 requests/minute.
Get detailed information about a specific user, including subscriptions, transaction count, and quota summary.
Block or unblock a user. Set is_active to false to block, true to unblock. Logs the action with an optional reason.

query.description: Max records to return. Min: 1, Max: 100 (default: 50)

request.description: Get paginated image generation activity logs (ImageLog entries) for a specific user.

query.description: Max records to return. Min: 1, Max: 100 (default: 50)

request.description: Get paginated transaction history (payments) for a specific user.
Manually assign a subscription plan to a user (admin action, no payment required). Cancels any existing active subscription first.

item.name: Admin - Plan Management
item.description: Admin CRUD endpoints for managing subscription plans.

request.description: Create a new subscription plan. If billing_interval ('monthly' or 'yearly') is provided, creates a Razorpay recurring plan. Leave billing_interval null for one-time payment plans.
Get all subscription plans. Admin-only. Optionally include inactive/soft-deleted plans.
Get details of a specific plan by ID.
Update plan details. All fields are optional (partial update). Cannot modify billing_interval or Razorpay plan after creation.
Soft-delete a plan by setting is_active to false. Cannot delete plans that have active subscriptions.
Get subscription statistics for a specific plan (active, canceled, expired, quota-exhausted counts).
Get quick overview stats for the admin dashboard (total users, revenue, active subscriptions, etc.).
Get time-series sales analytics with revenue breakdown by payment provider.
Get time-series user registration and active user analytics.
Get per-plan analytics: subscription counts, revenue, active users, and churn rates.

item.name: Admin - Reconciliation
item.description: Payment reconciliation endpoints for syncing transactions with Razorpay/Stripe.

request.description: Sync transactions with payment provider API for a given date range. Provider options: 'razorpay' (Stripe not yet implemented). Rate limited to 5 requests/minute due to external API calls.
Get all transactions with reconciliation discrepancies (unmatched status). These require manual review.

query.description: Optional note explaining the manual reconciliation

request.description: Manually mark a transaction as reconciled. Use for transactions that cannot be auto-reconciled but have been verified. Sets reconciliation_status to 'manual'.

header.description: Svix message ID — provided by Clerk/Svix

request.description: ⚠️ Internal webhook endpoint called by Clerk (via Svix). Do not call manually in production. Handles user.created, user.updated, user.deleted events to sync user data with local DB.
